title: Llama 2 7B decode, tp = 2, FWS-CIM CTT macro chiplets
subtitle: P5 phase-0 fixture. Hand-authored placement; capacities, areas and timing recorded from the reference run.

provenance.author: P5.1 fixture. No producer emits fws_atlas/1 yet; P3 and P4 code against this file.
grounded: metrics[] throughput, period (decode.* of the report)
the byte law behind links[].basis (batch x width x bf16)
provenance.note: The tp = 2 placement as a whole is hand-authored: the fws_cim path runs at tp = 1 and no mapper emits tiles yet. Every number a reader might quote as a result carries a basis string, and the figures recorded at tp = 1 are disclosed in relaxations[].

relaxations.reason: The drawn placement is tp = 2 and hand-authored; P3 has not emitted it. Throughput, period and duty-cycle figures come from the tp = 1 run of the same model and hardware config and do not describe this mapping.
A1 / D17: fully-connected p2p, analytical. Link bytes are drawn; link times are not derived anywhere.
The reference run reports boundary.bandwidth_bound = false. No per-link bandwidth limit is applied to the tp or act links drawn here.
D12: the per-macro digital pool is sized never to block the pipeline and is reported, not constrained. P2.5 owns the derivation; the numbers here are invented.
